title: Reading Drill — Sails Made from Discarded Fabric
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Sails Made from Discarded Fabric
passages.body:
**A** A design class received leftover fabric from a sewing business. Students cut equal strips and hung weights from them to compare tensile strength before building small model sails.

**B** The strongest strip was not necessarily the best choice. Some cloth resisted tearing yet stretched enough to lose its shape once tied to the model frame.

**C** The finished models were tested with a fan at a fixed distance. Students reported only the performance of their own models because the experiment did not represent outdoor wind.
